item.title: Germany's Merz visits Kyiv as Russia strikes bridge
item.description: As air raid sirens sounded in Kyiv, Chancellor Merz called on President Putin to end his "senseless war" and announced new measures to support Ukraine, including plans for joint Ukrainian-German drone production.

item.title: Trump names AI czar to head White House task force
item.description: US President Donald Trump has chosen members to lead a new AI task force to coordinate the administration's response to the rapidly evolving technology.

item.title: Torrential rain and flooding leave 2 dead and 1 missing in Spain's Catalonia region
item.description: Authorities warned of extreme danger around Barcelona and Girona, with rivers at risk of overflowing and residents urged to stay indoors.
